title: Death Momotaro
description:
DEATH MOMOTARO is a ridiculous horror-action comedy game based on the classic Japanese folktale Momotaro. 

Recommended for streamers who are good at witty comebacks!

DEATH MOMOTARO — Born from a Peach

Chapter 1: DEATH PEACHRun for your life from the giant kitchen knife swung down by DEATH Grandpa!

Chapter 2: DEATH ANIMALSFace off against DEATH Dog, DEATH Monkey, and DEATH Pheasant!
Stop them in their tracks with landmines, then force-feed them DEATH Kibi Dango!

Chapter 3: DEATH ONIGASHIMABlast the wicked Oni with bullets of JUSTICE!

Chapter 4: DEATH ???What awaits DEATH MOMOTARO at the end of his journey...?

Estimated Playtime: About 1 Hour

Streaming and Let's Plays are more than welcome!

For Players Outside JapanMomotaro is one of the most famous folktales in Japan. Almost everyone in Japan grows up knowing the story.

Here's how the original goes:

Once upon a time, there lived an old man and an old woman.

One day, while the old woman was washing clothes by the river, she saw an enormous peach floating downstream. She took it home, and when they cut the peach open, a healthy baby boy popped out from inside!

The couple named him Momotaro, meaning "Peach Boy," and raised him as their own.

When Momotaro grew up, he decided to travel to Onigashima, the Island of Oni, to defeat the Oni who had been terrorizing people.

Along the way, Momotaro met a dog, a monkey, and a pheasant. He shared his kibi dango, a type of Japanese dumpling, with them, and the three animals joined him on his journey to Onigashima.

When they reached the island, Momotaro and his new companions joined forces and fought the Oni together. Eventually, the Oni leader surrendered and returned all the treasure they had stolen.

Momotaro returned home with the dog, monkey, and pheasant, bringing the treasure with him.

And they all lived happily ever after.

If the game crashes on startup

On some PC configurations, the game may crash when running with DirectX 12.

If this occurs, launch the game from your Steam Library and select:
“Launch with DirectX 11 (if the game crashes normally)”

Updating your graphics driver to the latest version may also resolve the issue.
